widget.instructions: Press Play to watch the ball leave the table.

args.text: The fall time depends only on the height; the horizontal speed sets how far it goes in that time.

stem: A ball rolls off a table top {{h}} m above the floor at {{u}} m/s horizontally. Take g = 9.8 m/s².
How far from the foot of the table does it land?

hints.text: The horizontal and vertical motions are independent.
Vertically it falls {{h}} m from rest: h = ½gt².

forgot-root-fall-time.text: The fall time is √(2h ÷ g): you left out the square root.

range-formula-misapplied.text: u² sin 2θ ÷ g is for launch and landing at the same height. Here the ball falls {{h}} m.

dimension-mismatch.text: Check the unit: the answer is a length.

generic.text: t = √(2h ÷ g), then distance = u t.

range-formula-misapplied.front: Horizontal launch from a height h: how far out does it land?
range-formula-misapplied.back: x = u √(2h ÷ g); the u² sin 2θ ÷ g formula is for launch and landing at the same height.

generic.front: Horizontal launch from height h at speed u: distance?

accessibility.altText: A ball rolling off a table top.
accessibility.nonDragAlternative: Use Play and the time slider; type your answer in the box.
